blocks.en: The Spectrum of a Compact Operator
blocks.label: subsec:compact-operator-spectrum

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
In this section we prove a number of results about the spectrum of a compact operator. Since compact operators are bounded, the spectrum of a compact operator has all of the properties described in Section~\ref{subsec:bounded-operator-spectra}. Of course, with the added hypothesis of compactness, we can say a good bit more. We restrict ourselves to the case of operators on Hilbert space, though many of the results we give can be generalized to operators on Banach spaces.

In Hilbert spaces we can make use of the projection theorem and its consequences. In order to make use of this, we begin with a description of the spectrum of an operator of finite rank.
blocks.zh:
本节证明关于紧算子谱的若干结果. 由于紧算子有界, 紧算子的谱具有 Section~\ref{subsec:bounded-operator-spectra} 中所述的全部性质. 当然, 加上紧性假设后, 可以得到更多结论. 这里只限于 Hilbert 空间上的算子, 不过所给出的许多结果都可以推广到 Banach 空间上的算子.

在 Hilbert 空间中, 可以利用投影定理及其推论. 为利用这一点, 先描述有限秩算子的谱.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Suppose $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ has finite rank. Then for every $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}\backslash\{0\}$ exactly one of the following holds: either\begin{enumerate}\item $\lambda\in\rho(A)$, or\item $\lambda\in\sigma_p(A)$. In this case $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue of finite multiplicity.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 假设 $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ 具有有限秩. 那么对每个 $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}\backslash\{0\}$, 以下两种情形恰有一种成立:\begin{enumerate}\item $\lambda\in\rho(A)$, 或者\item $\lambda\in\sigma_p(A)$. 此时 $\lambda$ 为有限重数的特征值.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: lem:finite-rank-spectrum-alternative

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof follows directly from the corresponding result of linear algebra and is left to the reader (Problem~\ref{ex:finite-rank-spectrum-alternative-proof}).
blocks.zh: 证明直接来自线性代数中的相应结果, 留给读者 (Problem~\ref{ex:finite-rank-spectrum-alternative-proof}).

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We now prove a slightly different version of the Fredholm alternative theorem for operators of finite rank. This version is really just a technical result which will be useful in proving the analytic Fredholm theorem below (Theorem~\ref{thm:analytic-fredholm}).
blocks.zh: 现在对有限秩算子证明 Fredholm 二择一定理的一个略有不同的版本. 这一版本实际上只是一个技术性结果, 在证明下面的解析 Fredholm 定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:analytic-fredholm}) 时将会用到.
